full_judgment: Shahabuddin Ahmed. J.- In this appeal by special leave the question for determination is whether the provision for restitution as contained in section 144 of the Code or Civil Procedure, briefly the 'Code', is applicable to an order in a pre-emption case under section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act. 1950.
